contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONS[TANT] (I ?)VS AVG ; R/ GLORI-A EXER-CITVS

Copper alloy Nummus of Constantius II, as Augustus. Trier, AD340-341. Reece period 17. Obverse shows laureate and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads CONS[TANT] (I ?)VS AVG. Reverse shows 2 soldiers and one Standard. Reverse legend reads GLORI-A EXER-CITVS. -//TRP(?). Condition very fine, die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight 1.17g, diameter 14.71mm. RIC VIII, p.144,c.f.101A.
